memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in all activities of daily living; walks unaided, manages household chores.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5; no concerns.
falls: No falls in the last 12 months; gait normal; timed up-and-go 9 seconds.
medicines: 6 regular (amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, losartan 50 mg OD, hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD, levetiracetam 500 mg BD, lamotrigine 50 mg BD); polypharmacy – please review against Beers criteria.
mood: Reports stable mood, denies anxiety or depressive symptoms.
carers: Mother, Lakshmi.
goals: "I want to remain seizure-free and maintain good blood pressure control."
